title: Shel Silverstein
subtitle: Interactive editorial website
description: An interactive editorial website exploring Shel Silverstein's books and visual world.

components.heading: Shel Silverstein Artwork
paragraphs: This interactive editorial site brings Shel Silverstein’s illustration and writing into a scrolling browser experience. A fixed visual layer, responsive navigation, and animated gallery system frame the work without competing with its hand-drawn character.
The project organizes books and biographical material into an exploratory structure, using the browser as an exhibition space rather than a conventional article page.
Custom SVG assets, layered motion, responsive menus, and typographic restraint create a digital experience that stays close to the directness of the source material.
